description: Manage your Solo websites (draft + published), custom domains, and share invites directly against Firestore, the same backend the soloist.ai designer uses.

tools.name: domains_create
tools.description: Create a custom domain mapping. Optional: documentId.

tools.name: domains_delete
tools.description: Delete a domain mapping. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: domains_get
tools.description: Get one domain mapping document by id. Required: id.

tools.name: domains_list
tools.description: List your custom domains (runQuery on WebsiteDomains where userId == you).

tools.name: draft-websites_create
tools.description: Create a new draft website document. Optional: documentId.

params.name: documentId
params.description: Optional explicit document id (UUID). Firestore generates one if omitted.

tools.name: draft-websites_delete
tools.description: Delete a draft website document. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: draft-websites_get
tools.description: Get one draft website document by id (full JSON — pages, sections, theme). Required: id.

tools.name: draft-websites_list
tools.description: List your website drafts (runQuery on DraftWebsites where userId == you).

tools.name: draft-websites_update
tools.description: Update fields on a draft website. Use updateMask.fieldPaths (repeatable) to patch specific paths (e.g. theme.primaryColor) without replacing the doc. Required: id. Optional: updateMask.fieldPaths. Partial update.

params.name: updateMask.fieldPaths
params.description: Field path(s) to update; repeat for multiple. Omit to replace all provided fields.

tools.name: invites_create
tools.description: Create a share invite for a website. Optional: documentId.

tools.name: invites_delete
tools.description: Revoke a share invite. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: invites_get
tools.description: Get one invite document by id. Required: id.

tools.name: invites_list
tools.description: List share invites (runQuery on WebsiteInvites by websiteId or invited email).

tools.name: websites_delete
tools.description: Delete a published website document. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: websites_get
tools.description: Get one published website document by id. Required: id.

tools.name: websites_list
tools.description: List your published websites (runQuery on Websites where userId == you).

tools.name: websites_update
tools.description: Update fields on a published website document. Required: id. Optional: updateMask.fieldPaths. Partial update.

params.name: updateMask.fieldPaths
params.description: Field path(s) to update; repeat for multiple.
